provider_receipt.summary: Review completed. Named defects: (1) src/lib.rs:56-89 MemoryStore::store only serializes a MemoryRecord and discards it, so scan_vault provides no durable memory persistence despite the documented persistent-memory interface. (2) src/lib.rs:141,166-180 labels outgoing wikilinks from the current note as backlinks; it never discovers notes that link to the current note. (3) src/lib.rs:110-114 silently drops WalkDir traversal errors, allowing incomplete scans to report success. (4) src/lib.rs:184-192 permits rooted/parent-relative wikilinks to resolve outside the vault, violating the vault boundary. (5) src/lib.rs:94-103 checks only existence, not that vault_path is a directory, so a regular file is accepted as a vault. (6) docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md:71-93 defines required metadata and categorical confidence values that are incompatible with NoteFrontmatter at src/lib.rs:15-25 and the fixtures, so contract-conforming notes cannot be ingested by this implementation. The parent receipt supports its narrow README identity/purpose and clean-tree claims, but it contains no test or source evidence supporting broader implementation correctness.
